item_desc3010711.en: This elixir is specially made for those looking for something deviant. Once taken, its user will be overwhelmed by an exciting feeling of hotness and dizziness. However, it can also loosen the bowels and cause certain embarrassment. Despite its side effects, the elixir is also useful in duels if its quality is high enough since some cultivators would swallow it and spray flames from an unexpected place and take their enemies by surprise.

Despite its side effects, the elixir is also useful in duels if its quality is high enough since some cultivators would swallow it and spray flames from an unexpected place and take their enemies by surprise.
item_desc3010754.ch: 此丹常被寻求刺激之人所追求，服用下去周身火热，气血沸腾，灵台一阵飘飘然。副作用会使人肠道松软，无法闭气。若此丹品质够好，可从腚处喷出火焰，在与人对决中可打对方一个措手不及，实在是妙用无穷！

item_desc3010911.en: This is a sinister poison containing the ferocious power of Nether Essence. It will render the Energy in its victim's body unstable and release it in a grim explosion. It is poisonous even to the beast lords that cultivate with Nether Essence. Available in battle: once thrown out, the elixir may trigger an instakill on the enemy hit. The effect's triggering chance will decrease as the enemy's realm increases.
item_desc3010911.ch: 此丹阴险至极，内涵汹涌暴烈的冥元之力，中毒者全身力量狂暴，立即爆体而亡，依靠冥元进行修炼的妖兽之王也无法抵挡。战斗中丢至敌人身处，命中后有概率直接杀死敌方，中毒者境界越高，丹药效果越差。

item_desc3021011.en: The Zouyu is a rarely-spotted legendary beast. It resembles a tiger, but with white fur and black patterns and a tail longer than its body. It does not prey on living creatures and can walk over a thousand kilometers a day, making it an excellent mount.
item_desc3021011.ch: 驺吾是八荒世界传说中的仁兽。一种十分珍贵的神兽，个体如老虎一般，身上有五彩斑斓的花纹，尾巴比身子要长，像白毛黑纹的虎，但不吃活的禽兽，很能走，骑上能日行千里。

item_desc3021021.en: The Tenghuang is a mystic beast. "The Nation of the White People is located to the north of where the Longyu can be found. The people there are white-skinned and long-haired. In the kingdom there's a beast called Tenghuang, which resembles a fox but with a horn on its back. Those who ride it shall live to two thousand years old." —Classic of Regions Beyond the Seas: West
item_desc3021021.ch: 乘黄是八荒世界传说中的异兽。《山海经·海外西经》：“白民之国在龙鱼北，白身披发。有乘黄，其状如狐，其背上有角，乘之寿二千岁。 ”

item_desc3021031.en: "To its north is the home of the Longyu. This fish resembles the common carp, though some say it's larger, with long whiskers." —Classic of Regions Beyond the Seas: West
item_desc3021031.ch: 《山海经·海外西经》：“龙鱼陵居在其北，状如貍。一曰鰕。”

item_desc3021041.en: A heavy sword forged with dark iron. It's rather wide and unsuited for combat.
item_desc3021041.ch: 玄铁铸造的重剑。剑身宽大，不适合用作战斗。

item_desc3021051.en: A heavy sword forged with dark iron. It's rather wide and unsuited for combat.
item_desc3021051.ch: 玄铁铸造的重剑。剑身宽大，不适合用作战斗。

item_desc3021061.en: A long, slender metal weapon that is sharp in the head. In its rear is a short hilt and blades on both sides.
item_desc3021061.ch: 由金属制成，长条形，前端尖，后端安有短柄，两边有刃。

item_desc3021071.en: The sword has been a revered item since ancient times, highly valued by both humans and gods. It is the ancestor of all melee weapons and requires unparalleled skill.
item_desc3021071.ch: 剑，古之圣品也，至尊至贵，人神咸崇。乃短兵之祖，近搏之器，以道艺精深，遂入玄传奇。

item_desc3021081.en: Zhanlu is a sword with spiritual capabilities. Despising its morally depraved owner, Helu, it traveled to the Chu Kingdom instead.
item_desc3021081.ch: 湛卢之剑恶阖闾之无也，乃去而出，水行如楚。

item_desc3021091.en: A sword is a weapon used in dire straits. It is also a weapon to be kept close and concealed in your arms.
item_desc3021091.ch: 剑，检也，所以防检非常也；又敛也，以其在身拱时敛在臂内也。

item_desc3021101.en: "In the nation of Quanfeng, there is a grand horse named Jiliang, with a snowy white body, a crimson mane and golden eyes. Those who ride it shall live to one thousand years old." —Classic of Regions Within the Seas: North
item_desc3021101.ch: 《山海经·海内北经》：（犬封国）有文马，缟身朱鬣，目若黄金，名曰吉量，乘之寿千岁。

item_desc3021111.en: "Mt. Qin is rich in mineral ores and jades but not ordinary rocks. The Shi waters originate from here, flowing into Haoze in the north. Lots of eels and colorful shellfish can be found in the waters. In the mountains is a beast shaped much like a fanged boar. When it roars, it sounds like it's saying 'Dangkang', which is how it got its name. Wherever it is spotted, there is likely to be bountiful harvests."—Classic of the Mountains: East II
item_desc3021111.ch: 《山海经·东次四经》：钦山，多金玉而无石。师水出焉，而北流注于皋泽，其中多鳝鱼，多文贝。有兽焉。其状如豚而有牙，其名曰当康，其鸣自叫，见则天下大穰。

item_desc3021121.en: "Three hundred kilometers to the north, there's a mountain called Mt. Dai. It's bountiful in jade and blue stones. In the mountains is a beast shaped much like a horse, but with a pronged horn on its head. Its name is Shu and can be used to ward off fires." Classic of the Mountains: North
item_desc3021121.ch: 《山海经·北山经》：又北三百里，曰带山，其上多玉，其下多青碧。有兽焉，其状如马，一角有错，其名曰疏，可以辟火。

item_desc3021131.en: An exorbitant treasure that symbolizes status and skill. The common cultivator will have a hard time harnessing something like this.
item_desc3021131.ch: 八荒世界中价格高昂的宝物，是身份与实力的象征！寻常修仙者只能望而却步。

item_desc3021141.en: The River Guai originates from here, flowing east into the Xianyi waters. This river is home to many Xuanguis, a beast shaped like a turtle, yet with a bird's head and a snake's tail. Their cries sound like the noise made when chopping wood. This beast is good for ear health and can also be used to heal calluses on the feet.
item_desc3021141.ch: 怪水出焉，而东流注于宪翼之水。其中多玄龟，其状如龟而鸟首虺尾，其名曰旋龟，其音如判木，佩之不聋，可以为底。

item_desc3021176.en: "Every spring, yellow carps will congregate at the Dragon's Gate from the oceans and rivers. However, only 72 fish are able to get past the Dragon's Gate each year. Those that succeed are followed by thunderclouds, with heavenly flames burning their tail. With this, the carp becomes a dragon." —Anecdotes of the Three Qins
item_desc3021176.ch: 《三秦记》：“每岁季春，有黄鲤鱼，自海及诸川，争来赴之。一岁中，登龙门者，不过七十二。初登龙门，即有云雨随之，天火自后烧其尾，乃化为龙矣。”

item_desc3021186.en: Magical cloud that soars high above the mountaintops, permitting the rider to travel without leaving a trace, as clear showers gather below.
item_desc3021186.ch: 翱游于八荒之巅的灵云，来去无踪，聚集之下可定八荒晴雨。

item_desc3021196.en: Freakish-looking, purple-blue egg, nestled by clouds. What creature grows inside and whether or not it can be reared is unclear.
item_desc3021196.ch: 通体紫蓝的奇异之卵，其下有云雾相托。不知卵中孕育何物，能否被孵化而出。

item_desc3021206.en: Flying boat constructed by master craftsmen from precious materials. Well-made and durable, it is a must-have mode of transport for the discerning traveler.
item_desc3021206.ch: 由八荒炼器宗师所制的飞舟，取材珍贵，耐用结实，实在是居家旅行必备佳品。

item_desc3021216.en: Thought to originate in a faraway realm, this cloud was carelessly left behind at some immortal banquet. Only encountered by incredibly lucky individuals, it has the ability to turn your fortunes around.
item_desc3021216.ch: 据说此物曾是仙界之云，在仙人礼乐歌舞时不慎遗落八荒。只有身具大造化之人才能得遇，见之即有逢凶化吉之效。

item_desc3021226.en:
"A hundred and twenty kilometers to the north, there's a mountain called Mt. Shangshen. It's bountiful in rocks, but no grass or trees can survive there. At its foot are hazels and thistles, and white deer are the main beasts there. Danghu, the main bird there, looks like a pheasant and can fly with its beard as wings. Eating its flesh can prevent blindness." Classic of the Mountains: West.
Very sensitive to the smell of Taoist Mind. Can find Taoist Fruit for its master sometimes. (At most once per year.)
item_desc3021226.ch:
《山海经·西山经》：“又北百二十里，曰上申之山，上无草木，而多硌石，下多榛、楛，兽多白鹿。其鸟多当扈，其状如雉，以其髯飞，食之不眴目。”
对道心的气息极为敏感，有时能够为主人寻来道心果（1年内最多只可触发1次）

item_desc3021236.en:
"Three hundred kilometers to the south, there's a mountain called Mt. Gufeng. It's bountiful in gold and jade, but no grass or trees can survive there. There is a beast there that looks like a fox with wings and honks like a wild goose. It's called Bibi and is believed to forebode a severe drought." Classic of the Mountains: East.
Has a certain chance to convert a cultivator killed by its master into Taoist Fruit. (At most once per year.)
item_desc3021236.ch:
《山海经·东山经》：“又南三百里，曰姑逢之山，无草木，多金玉。有兽焉，其状如狐而有翼，其音如鸿雁，其名曰獙獙，见则天下大旱。”
有一定几率将被主人所杀的修仙者转化为道心果（1年内最多只可触发1次）

item_desc3021241.en: A Flying Sword condensed from the most obscure cold Qi in this world. You cannot find any trace of Nether Air on it, and its quality is even comparable to the swords of the Immortals.
item_desc3021241.ch: 由八荒至阴至寒的灵气凝结而成的飞剑，除了不含半分冥气外，已然无限接近于仙剑的品质。

item_desc3021256.en: A compass designed based on the calculation of the Eight Trigrams, the course of mountains and rivers, and the orbit of stars and planets. Its surface seems to mirror the vast starry sky of the Immortal Realm. According to the inspection by the Master of the Pavilion, it must be an outlandish trinket never known to this world, thus it is regarded as an invaluable treasure here.
item_desc3021256.ch: 将九宫八卦、山川河流与日月星辰结合演化的罗盘，透过其中似乎可窥见仙界浩瀚星空。经琅琊阁主鉴定，此物绝非八荒山海所能诞生之物，故珍贵异常，乃是八荒稀世至宝。

item_desc3031101.en: Artifact forged with a Rallying Horn as a core, summons forth Dangkang clansmen to surround the enemy.
item_desc3031101.ch: 使用引群之号为核心炼制而成的器形，奏之能够唤来当康族人围攻对手。

item_desc3031102.en: Artifact forged with a Horn of Lightning as a core, can summon lightning to attack enemies.
item_desc3031102.ch: 使用唤雷之角为核心炼制而成的器形，用之可以召唤闪电攻击敌人。

item_desc3031103.en: Artifact forged with a Wailing Chime as a core, attacks cause dizziness and immobility.
item_desc3031103.ch: 使用苍鸣之磬为核心炼制而成的器形，击之能让生灵头晕目眩、动弹不得。

item_desc3031104.en: Artifact forged with a Dusty Visage as a core, terrifies enemies the moment they look at it.
item_desc3031104.ch: 使用绝尘之面为核心炼制而成的器形，敌人一旦与之对视便会陷入恐惧。

item_desc3031105.en: Artifact forged with a Cloudfire Tail as a core, summons fire to burn enemies.
item_desc3031105.ch: 使用云焰之尾为核心炼制而成的器形，挥之能够召唤火焰灼烧敌人。

item_desc3031107.en: Artifact forged with a Windcheater Robe as a core, unfurling it will harness the power of storms.
item_desc3031107.ch: 使用风匿之袍为核心炼制而成的器形，披之可以为己方带来风暴之力。

item_desc3031108.en: Sword forged from Star Pyrite, lends the wielder unstoppable power, as though they can cut the sky!
item_desc3031108.ch: 使用星硫铁打造而成的剑，挥动之间剑气乱舞、无人可抵，似有斩天之能。

item_desc3031109.en: Artifact forged with a Devourer's Seal as a core, constantly summons space-twisting fields to devour enemies.
item_desc3031109.ch: 使用贪恶玺为核心炼制而成的器形，不断召唤出扭曲空间的力场吞噬敌人。

item_desc3031110.en: Artifact forged with a Guqin of Nether Melody as a core, renders pleasant songs as well as somber tunes.
item_desc3031110.ch: 使用阴曲琴为核心炼制而成的器形，可奏出天籁之音亦或是阴幽之曲。
